spanish: Si sobre agradecimiento lo acercará, y acercará sobre sacrificio del agradecimiento tortas ázimas mezcladas en el aceite, y obleas ázimas untadas en el aceite, y harina fina revuelta, tortas mezcladas en el aceite.

units.es: tortas ázimas mezcladas en el aceite
y obleas ázimas untadas en el aceite

grammarChanges: acercare → acercará (h03007012004): Hiphil imperfect 3ms resolved to indicative future 3ms; the -are form is identical for 1st and 3rd person singular and is not the yiqtol's mood.
amasadas → mezcladas (h03007012011, h03007012020): qal passive participle of H1101 licenses mixed/mingled; mezcladas keeps that sense instead of narrowing to kneading.
sólet → harina fina (h03007012017): H5560 is a common noun and must be translated, not left as an untranslated Hebrew form.
remojada → revuelta (h03007012018): hophal passive participle of H7246 stays open between mixed/stirred and soaked; revuelta keeps the mixed/stirred sense instead of resolving to soaking.
readerNote: Chose revuelta over the narrower soaked sense for the H7246 hophal participle, since the stem leaves mixed/stirred and soaked both open and only one Spanish word could be used.
